reviewed_ordinary_mathematical_inference.quantifiers: Fix alpha in(0,1). For every integer T above the fixed threshold there exists a possibly T-dependent convex1-Lipschitz differentiable loss sequence with actual OGD zero-comparator regret at least phi(alpha) T^(2-alpha)/2.
reviewed_ordinary_mathematical_inference.normalized_bound: Since T>0, for that same witness R_T(0)/T >= (phi(alpha)/2)*T^(1-alpha).
reviewed_ordinary_mathematical_inference.meaning: phi(alpha)>0 and1-alpha>0, so these lower certificates grow unbounded as T grows. Equivalently, for any proposed uniform sublinear regret guarantee over allowed loss sequences, sufficiently large horizons have counterexamples. This inference uses ordinary real-power algebra/growth, not a newly formalized Tendsto declaration.
not_claimed: One fixed infinite loss stream has divergent normalized regret
A Lean Tendsto theorem for normalized regret or a Lean supremum-based worst-case functional has been proved
All online algorithms fail in this setting

source_Lean_delta: Literal Theorem5.4 OSD affine construction also drives actual OGD. Global differentiability is proved for this witness. For each sufficiently large T there is a T-dependent sequence; no Lean Tendsto, fixed infinite sequence or all-schedules claim.
